player_prompt.intro:
Wena u mkuruleni {player_id} u tlhelela giya ra Pig Dice.

Milawu:
- Eturn ya wena, u nga endli '[roll]' kuya na '[hold]'
- Rolla 2-6: Nyika eka kontente ya turn ya wena
- Rolla 1: Hlula kontente ya turn na ku endla turn
- Emela: Nyika kontente ya turn ya wena eka skore na ku endla turn
- Xiyengxa xa kufikela {winning_score} dipointi ndi xiyengxa xa kuduma

Loko ku va turn ya wena, u ta vona kontente ya sasa na kontente ya turn.
Yisa '[roll]' ku rolla die kuya na '[hold]' ku nyika dipointi ta wena.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Swiviko swo hambana. Usisa '[roll]' kuya na '[hold]'.

actions.player_hold: Mkuruleni {player_id} u emela na ku nyika {turn_total} dipointi.
